The Wi-Tek WI-AX1800M V2 AX1800 Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 Wireless Mesh Router is a high-performance networking solution designed to deliver fast, stable, and seamless wireless connectivity for homes and businesses. Powered by the latest Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, this router provides combined wireless speeds of up to 1800Mbps, ensuring smooth streaming, gaming, and high-speed internet access.


With dual-band connectivity, the router offers 574Mbps on the 2.4GHz band for wider coverage and 1201Mbps on the 5GHz band for high-speed performance. The Mesh networking capability allows multiple devices to work together to create a unified Wi-Fi network, eliminating dead zones and providing seamless roaming throughout large spaces.


The router features Gigabit WAN and LAN ports for ultra-fast wired connections and supports cloud management, enabling administrators to monitor and manage the network remotely. Advanced features such as beamforming technology, WPA3 security, and high-gain antennas ensure strong signal coverage and secure connectivity.


The Wi-Tek WI-AX1800M V2 is ideal for homes, offices, hotels, retail shops, and enterprise environments, providing reliable and scalable Wi-Fi coverage with easy installation and centralized management.


Key Features


  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) dual-band technology
  • Total wireless speed up to 1775–1800 Mbps
  • 574 Mbps on 2.4 GHz + 1201 Mbps on 5 GHz
  • Mesh networking for seamless Wi-Fi coverage
  • Cloud management for remote monitoring
  • Beamforming technology for stronger signal
  • Supports 100+ connected devices
  • WPA3 wireless security
  • Ideal for homes, offices, hotels, schools, and shops
